scope: All decoded static UI assets and indexed nontexture children in packs 02:00028 through 02:00033. This is a finite setup/options subset, not all game interface text.
coordinate_convention: Rects are [x,y,width,height] within decoded sprites. Full extents identify exact source image dimensions; embedded inspection regions are conservative manual bounds and are not final pixel masks. Source graphic data offsets remain in source index.
translation_policy: Full meaning first; no truncation to source pixel or byte budget. Preserve button icons, arrows, dynamic placeholders, keyboard data, and numeric examples. Apply independent meaning review before scripted glossary normalization.

corrections.reason: Native button/background textures resolve ambiguous screenshot. Prior files and review provenance remain unchanged.

uncertainties: Auto-Name label leaves random generation versus restoring default unasserted; runtime behavior needs checking.
Seven embedded thumbnail text regions are uncertain or unreadable at native resolution and need matching battle UI evidence.
Matching decoded image hashes establish image duplicates, not necessarily identical runtime behavior.
Source text in images was transcribed visually; source line wrapping and punctuation should be checked by the meaning reviewer.

entries.source_visible:
「機界ロレイラル」
機械兵士らを生み出す
高度な機械文化が
発達している世界。
攻撃召喚が最も多い属性。
威力も高いが消費ＭＰも若干高い。
entries.target_full:
Machine World: Loreilal
A world with an advanced mechanical civilization that creates mechanical soldiers and other machines.
This affinity has the most offensive summons. They are powerful, but their MP costs are also somewhat higher.
entries.notes: Full meaning draft; original 200x136 image is not an English length budget. Proposed glossary spellings require review. No omission to fit.

entries.source_visible:
「鬼妖界シルターン」
妖怪、龍神、鬼神
といった人ならざるものと
人間が共存している世界。
攻撃と異常・憑依効果を与える
召喚がメイン。異常・憑依効果は
敵を不利にするものが多い。
entries.target_full:
Yokai World: Silturn
A world where humans coexist with supernatural beings such as yokai, dragon gods, and oni gods.
Its summons mainly attack or apply status ailments and possession effects. Many of these effects put enemies at a disadvantage.
entries.notes: Full meaning draft; original 200x136 image is not an English length budget. Proposed glossary spellings require review. No omission to fit.

entries.source_visible:
「霊界サプレス」
天使や悪魔といった
霊的生命体が暮らしている。
彼らは霊界では不死の存在。
回復・治癒に優れている属性。
異常、憑依効果も多い。
初心者向きの属性。
entries.target_full:
Spirit World: Sapureth
Home to spiritual beings such as angels and demons. They are immortal in the Spirit World.
An affinity that excels at recovery and healing, with many status ailment and possession effects. Well suited to beginners.
entries.notes: Full meaning draft; original 200x136 image is not an English length budget. Proposed glossary spellings require review. No omission to fit.

entries.source_visible:
「幻獣界メイトルパ」
豊かな自然が広がる大地。
獣の姿を持つ亜人や幻獣達が
平和に暮らしている世界。
全ての召喚効果において
バランスがとれている属性。
憑依効果に特殊なものがある。
entries.target_full:
Beast World: Maetropa
A land rich in nature, where beastlike humanoids and mythical beasts live in peace.
This affinity is balanced across all summon effects and has some unusual possession effects.
entries.notes: Full meaning draft; original 200x136 image is not an English length budget. Proposed glossary spellings require review. No omission to fit.
